title: Add routed cycle execution
prompt: Continue Phase 10 by adding provider-agnostic routed cycle execution that selects an eligible registered provider using the deterministic router, runs the existing cycle/checkpoint machinery, records provider_id in the returned execution metadata, and preserves sticky resume: a checkpoint with an existing provider/session must resume on that same provider rather than silently switching providers. Only a new/replanned task may select another provider. Add focused offline tests for primary success, quota fallback before session creation, sticky resume, unavailable sticky provider producing an explicit wait/replan outcome, and no eligible provider.
